method.name: SOPI propose from two lists
method.authority: Biblical text via MACULA clauses only. Spans from said_speeches + marked_formulas.
method.coming_act: yiqtol / weqatal / about.to participle / Greek future; qatal only if MACULA gloss already says will/coming
method.exclude_default: second-person assigned work (make, take, cover, bring, put, gather)
method.seam: After the head, a wayyiqtol whose verb is not אמר/דבר/נבא/צוה ends the proposal window; also a later-verse third-person qatal/wayyiqtol without will/coming gloss (soft cut of leaked narrator).
method.review: Accept or reject by hand into sopi/index.json. interpretation and later_scripture stay null.
